entities.summary: Filippo Iannone O.Carm. is an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who has been prefect of the Dicastery for Bishops and president of the Pontifical Commission for Latin America since 15 October 2025. He was prefect Dicastery for Legislative Texts from 2022 to 2025. He has been a bishop since 2001 and an archbishop since 2012. He is a member of the Carmelites. Filippo Iannone was a religious figures from Naples (b. 1957-12-13, Naples). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
